subject: ferrum
title: Tree-sitter-bash rejection policy with three enforced tiers; docs capability table IS the regression test
one_why: Nuance vs kimi-code/smelt: there is no approval prompt at all -- grammar verdicts are the authority, tiers are low/medium/high, and tier_capability_contract_is_table_driven asserts the exact allow/deny matrix published in docs/security.md, so docs and policy cannot drift.

subject: ferrum
title: Compaction re-appends immutable system/repo policy AFTER the generated summary so summarized text can never carry system authority
one_why: Most compaction implementations splice the summary into position 0 of the surviving list, letting attacker-seeded text inside the summarized range inherit whatever role the head message had; ferrum makes ordering an explicit invariant with a named test.

subject: ferrum
title: Trigger projects provider-reported context_tokens + estimated tail, checked before every request AND mid-loop, and refuses to send if the post-compaction projection still exceeds budget
one_why: Nuance vs mocode/zot: max(local_estimate, usage_projection) keeps the estimate as floor, and the hard bail after compaction converts a silent provider overflow into a diagnosable local error; compaction is skipped outright unless it strictly reduces tokens (mod.rs:4675).

subject: ferrum
title: Compiled-in fake provider scripted by env var drives whole-binary stdio conformance tests
one_why: The fake ships inside the release binary behind FERRUM_FAKE_SCRIPT, so 26 tests spawn the real ferrum executable over real stdio and assert protocol behavior end-to-end -- no test-only build flag, no network.

subject: ferrum
title: LoopGuard graduates Nudge then ForceFinal on fingerprint repeats and consecutive errors, under an explicit config limit and a hard 256-round ceiling
one_why: Single-fingerprint consecutive memory (crab-code-adjacent) plus an error streak, but the two-stage nudge-then-force-final shape and the always-on hard ceiling make it safe against both chatty and silent loops.

subject: ferrum
title: 477 tests including whole-binary protocol conformance with zero CI to run any of them
evidence: repo root: no .github/ or workflow files; tests/acp_stdio.rs:1702 LOC; ~13.0k inline #[cfg(test)] LOC across 62 src modules
one_why: Test quality is genuinely property-level (the census also missed 89% of it: test_loc 1659 vs real ~14.8k); a single cargo-test-on-push workflow converts the corpus's best small-project test suite into an enforcement guarantee.

subject: ferrum
title: agent/mod.rs is 10,178 LOC fusing the turn loop, compaction, TUI, completion, pickers, and slash commands
evidence: src/agent/mod.rs:10178 total; loop run_turn_inner:3147, compact:4588, completion/picker machinery :129-930
one_why: Provider/tool/session/acp planes are cleanly separated, so the fix is mechanical: the loop+compaction state machine (~3-4k LOC of mod.rs) is a ready-made crate boundary; today the product surface and the loop share one file's test namespace.

subject: ferrum
title: Per-spawn delegated cgroup-v2 with pre_exec attach and cgroup.kill for bash and MCP children
one_why: Not a security boundary (docs say so) but a real cleanup boundary: cancellation or timeout kills the entire descendant tree rather than leaking daemons, and the code fail-marks containment as unavailable instead of pretending.

subject: ferrum
title: Security docs grade every control and name the non-boundaries: not a sandbox, low-tier is accident-guard, containment note explicitly non-committal
one_why: Rarest posture in the corpus: the docs pre-empt exactly the overclaim reviewers catch elsewhere (phantom-safety-control family) by stating what the policy layer cannot see -- system calls of an allowed executable.

subject: ferrum
title: history_search/history_read tools query the session JSONL including pre-compaction archived messages, returning line numbers for follow-up reads
one_why: Makes compaction lossy-but-reversible: the model can recover detail the summary dropped by addressing JSONL lines, at read-only authority exempt from permission prompts while all mutating tools still gate.
